_policy: Pre-registered targets for the beat phase-selection round (board #4160), frozen 2026-10-16 BEFORE any variant was built or scored. Modeled on q_onset_frozen.json (q63-onset) and q3_key_frozen.json: numbers move or the change reverts. Variant selection reads the TUNE halves only; holdout halves are scored once, at round end, on the chosen config. Every candidate is measured alone and a rejected one is recorded with its evidence.
issue: With the tempo right, the beat grid often sits on the off-beat or a quarter off: on the Harmonix tune half 28% of emitted beats land on the half-beat and 54 of 180 tracks emit more off-beat than on-beat beats (board #4159). Against an in-TouchDesigner neural tracker on the same audio this is most of the beat gap (#4158).
mechanism_evidence: Board #4159 + this round's diagnosis on the baseline dumps (Harmonix tune, 438 beat segments split at >2.5-period gaps): segments START on-beat 150, off-beat 105, quarter-off 183; only 49 stable on/off flips happen inside segments. The phase is mostly decided when the grid anchors (on the first gated onset) and the PLL cannot escape a half-beat error: its capture reach is +-25% of a period, the true beat is 50% away. Batida house is phase-bimodal at baseline (2 of 6 seeds off-beat locked); batida techno sits 34-178 ms late on all 6 seeds.
design_constraint: Handover from the GH #63 round (#4160 note): a fixed low-band/kick-band reweight of the onset function moves phase in OPPOSITE directions by genre (techno .343 -> .526, house .809 -> .497), because house's off-beat bassline lives in the kick band. Candidates must therefore not reweight the PLL's evidence globally; the round tests SCORED COMPETING PHASE HYPOTHESES (switch the grid with hysteresis when an alternative phase clearly wins), with the evidence source as the variable. The shipped kick model (kick_model.rs, trained to reject bass notes) is computed before the beat detector on every hop, so it is available at zero latency.

split.rule: sha256(track_id) parity, even -> tune, odd -> holdout, on ballroom, harmonix and giantsteps_tempo (Harmonix included: its 10-track dev subset was already read in #4158/#4159, so none of it is treated as blind except the odd half)

tools.phase: bench/analyze_beat_phase.py <out_root> ballroom harmonix: per half, share of emitted beats on / anti (half-beat) / quarter, anti-locked track count, beat F
tools.batida: ~/ai/audio/kick-work/odf3743/run_batida.sh pattern, TEMPLATES='house techno' SEEDS='1 2 3 4 5 6', binary swapped for the round's
tools.td_head_to_head: bench/td_compare (branch td-signal): the 26-track dev subset vs lastBeatStanding / EssentiaTD, reported only (dev data)

baseline._provenance: main 1fd0c41, analyze build c63085076ed7d00f, run_bench defaults (30 Hz, stems), results + dumps ~/ai/audio/kick-work/q-onset/base (the GH #63 round's baseline, identical binary); split metrics ~/ai/audio/kick-work/q-phase/base_split.json, phase ~/ai/audio/kick-work/q-phase/base_phase.json. Tempo acc counts no-estimate as a miss.

targets.P1_motivating: harmonix holdout: phase_on >= 0.496 + 0.03 AND anti_locked < 59; batida house: fewer than 2 of 6 seeds off-beat locked (beat F < 0.7)
targets.P3_no_harm_ballroom: ballroom holdout beat_f >= 0.3701 - 0.005 (kick-sparse material: the arbiter should mostly stand aside)
targets.G1_ballroom: holdout acc1, acc2, cmlt, amlt, downbeat_f each >= baseline - 0.005; no_est <= 45
targets.G2_giantsteps_tempo: holdout acc1, acc2 each >= baseline - 0.005; no_est <= 2
targets.G3_harmonix: holdout acc1, acc2, cmlt, amlt, downbeat_f each >= baseline - 0.005; no_est <= 1
targets.G4_distribution: means hide offsetting losses (memory scalar-image-summary-cancels-errors): per-genre ballroom beat_f, no genre down by more than 0.02; tracks whose beat_f drops by more than 0.1 reported next to those that rise by more than 0.1, and the round must not lose more than it gains on either dataset
targets.G5_negatives: 155 beatless FMA clips: beats/min <= 28.2 + 1.0, pulse-low third <= 8.4 + 1.0, publish <= 53. A phase arbiter that adds grid shifts must not add beats where there is no beat
targets.G6_batida: techno: no seed worse than baseline beat F by more than 0.02, mean lag not later; every other template x 2 seeds (scorecard): beat F and tempo not worse by more than 0.01
targets.G7_structure_drop: harmonix all: drop hit_rate >= 0.0922 - 0.01, false_drops_per_min <= 0.4121 + 0.02, predict_drop false_alarms_per_min <= 2.0167 + 0.05 and coverage at 0.5 / 0.8 each >= baseline - 0.01, boundary_3_0s f >= 0.1424 - 0.005 (bar and phrase positions follow the grid)
targets.G9_build: cargo test (both CI feature sets), exact CI clippy sets (--all-targets, --features release), and clippy -p fosfora-app --lib --no-default-features (XR)
targets.G10_owner: Kevin watches it on his own music (live, with the TouchDesigner example and in the app) before release

on_miss: a missed guard reverts that candidate, or is stated with its numbers and explicitly accepted by Kevin; never silently
